items.title: Runner plan: one runner per two cores, allocated by measured demand
items.brief: scripts/mini/runner-plan.sh plans the mini's runners (9 on its 18 cores), at least one per scope that ran a job in 14 days and never fewer than 4 for runsheet; add-runner.sh and remove-runner.sh change them. ADR 029.
items.acceptance: `bash scripts/mini/runner-plan_test.sh` passes; scripts/mini/runner-plan.sh prints the plan without applying it; docs/adr/029 describes the allocation.
items.model_reason: one script with tests to copy

items.title: Measure: the mini's load p90 over a day
items.brief: scripts/mini/adr-029-measure.sh reads the mini's load every minute for a day and writes its p90 against the cores to docs/adr/029's After section. Never a merge gate: whatever the number, it is recorded.
items.acceptance: `bash scripts/mini/adr-029-measure.sh --dry-run` runs and prints a reading; docs/adr/029's After section records the reading it took, with when and under what load, whatever the number.
items.model_reason: a script and a recorded reading

items.title: Shard the e2e suite in three
items.brief: Cut the e2e suite into three shards by measured duration, balanced on planned seconds from a fresh whole-package timings run; each shard a job of the e2e workflow; a -check tool proves the lists disjoint and complete.
items.acceptance: `go test ./tools/shardplan/...` passes; the shards' balance is proven by planned-seconds balance and disjoint shard lists covering all 309 tests (`go run ./tools/shardplan -check` exits 0).

questions.clause: the mini's load p90 under 1.5 × cores
questions.question: The load p90 is a reading of the host (3.6 × cores today) that no pull request can satisfy: record it in the goal doc as not met and close the goal on the mechanism, or keep the goal open until the host changes?
